Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Colorado Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 37,597,975 megawatthours
B. 21,200,421 megawatthours

Source citation: Colorado Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/colorado/index.php)

Source text:
Colorado Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Colorado)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 19,817 | 22 |
| Electric utilities | 11,287 | 23 |
| IPP & CHP | 8,529 | 17 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 58,798,395 | 28 |
| Electric utilities | 37,597,975 | 25 |
| IPP & CHP | 21,200,421 | 21 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.

Supplied draft answer: A
Proposed correction: B
User's correction: I checked the cited source and believe the answer is B (21,200,421 megawatthours), not A (37,597,975 megawatthours). Please correct the draft to B.
